project_type: React/Vite SPA (src/) + Vercel serverless backend (api/index.js) + Express dev mirror (server/) + Supabase (Postgres) + optional Electron wrapper. Order-management dashboard.
language: JavaScript (ESM in src/ and server/; CommonJS require() in api/cron-daily-report.js). api/index.js uses ESM import.
build_system: Vite 5. Scripts in oms-dashboard/package.json: build = 'vite build', dev = concurrently client+server. No TypeScript, no linter config, no test framework. QUIRK: api/index.js is the ONLY production backend (deployed on Vercel); server/routes/orders.js is a dev-only mirror that MUST be kept consistent, but production correctness is judged on api/index.js.
test_framework: NONE. Do not add one. Verification is build + node --check only.
build_command: cd 'd:/OMS PRESTAIR SYSTEMS LLP/oms-dashboard'; npm run build
test_command: No test runner. Use: node --check api/index.js ; node --check api/cron-daily-report.js ; node --check server/routes/orders.js ; node --check server/setupSupabase.js (all from the oms-dashboard dir).
verification_instructions: From d:/OMS PRESTAIR SYSTEMS LLP/oms-dashboard run `npm run build` and confirm the Vite build completes with no errors. Then run `node --check` on every edited .js backend file (api/index.js, api/cron-daily-report.js, server/routes/orders.js) and confirm each exits 0. Do NOT start a long-running dev server. There is no automated test suite; correctness of DB logic is verified by code review of the move/restore/permanent-delete/payment-detection paths against the walkthrough in completed-payment-history-plan.md.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell shell. Do NOT start a dev server (npm run dev / dev:server). Supabase is a live hosted DB; the FK-drop migration api/payments-fk-migration.sql is flagged for MANUAL one-time run in the Supabase SQL editor and is NOT auto-applied by code. Do not touch Gmail/Supabase credentials embedded in api/cron-daily-report.js beyond adding the payments fetch.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/README/steering files exist in the repo. Conventions are inferred from code: every api/index.js backend change MUST be mirrored in server/routes/orders.js. Migrations are idempotent api/*-migration.sql files with a header comment pointing at the Supabase SQL editor, run manually. Preserve can_edit_receipt and can_edit_completed permission gates; restore and permanent-delete stay admin-only.
key_patterns: api/index.js endpoints are terse single-line handlers; server/routes/orders.js mirrors are multi-line and more readable. mapOrder(o) converts snake_case DB row -> camelCase API object (and computes balance/percentReceived); snakeOrder(o) converts back. Completed orders are JSON snapshots in deleted_orders.data keyed by original_id; GET /api/orders/deleted/all exposes each as {...data, id: original_id, deletedBy, deletedAt}. payments table rows are keyed by order_id. Cache: cacheDel('orders','deleted_orders','payments_all') after mutations. Order totals recompute: received=SUM(payments.amount for order_id); balance=total-received; percent = total ? round2(received/total*100) : 0.
